headline:
*twelve cuts a year*,
not one every four.

panes.title: SIZE OF ONE CUT
panes.sub: how much new supply disappears at once

panes.title: WHAT THAT MEANS
lines: *99,903 KAS* per day stop being minted from 4 nov on.

post.x: the kaspa block reward falls 5.61% on 4 nov. bitcoin does 50% once every four years. kaspa does one small step every month, and twelve of them land on the same 50%. the network mints 99,903 fewer KAS per day than before the cut, emission went from 1.78 million to 1.68 million.
post.reply: the emission numbers are on kaspapulse.com/kaspa-halving.html. the exact minute drifts, the cut lands on a block score, not a clock.
